newsitem.title: USA: May & Speh names Mason president, COO.
newsitem.headline: May & Speh names Mason president, COO.

text.p: May & Speh Inc said Wednesday it has named Peter Mason as president and chief operating officer.

The company said Mason will also become chief executive officer at the end of its fiscal year on September 30. The current chief executive Lawrence Speh will become vice chairman and Albert Speh Jr, the company's founder, will remain as chairman, the company said.
Mason will begin as president and chief operating officer on May 19, the company said. Lawrence Speh is currently serving as president, and the position of chief operating officer was newly created.
Mason, a May & Speh director, outside counsel and business advisor, was previously a partner in the Chicago law firm he co-founded, Freeborn & Peters.
The company said the changes are in keeping with its growth strategy.

At May & Speh, Mason will focus on day-to-day operations, including managing business processes to ensure client service. He also will continue building the organization, through investments in personnel recruitment and development, state-of-the-art technology, as well as research and development of new products and services, the company said.
May & Speh provides integrated data management services.
